caption: The drawing features a monochromatic, finely detailed depiction of a teapot centered within a large rectangular boundary. The teapot has a domed lid with a decorative finial on top, a rounded body, a pronounced base, and a large, ornate handle on the right side that curves upward and outward. On the left, the teapot has a long, curved spout that extends upward and outward in a smooth arc. At the bottom left corner of the image, there is a small rectangular inset depicting a top-down profile view of the finial, and at the bottom right corner, another small inset shows a schematic outline of the teapot including labeled measurements. The primary color of the drawing is graphite grey on a beige or off-white background. The shading and line work provide dimensionality and texture to the teapot. The composition is balanced with the main object centered and the two smaller technical illustrations in the lower corners.
title: Pewter Teapot
